description: This file defines the MonkeyWaitEvent class, which represents a throttle/wait event in the Android Monkey testing framework. The class includes a constructor that sets the wait time and an injectEvent method that causes the thread to sleep for the specified duration, optionally logging the wait, and handling interruption exceptions.

classes.name: MonkeyWaitEvent
classes.description: Represents a waiting/throttling event in the Monkey testing framework, sleeps for a specified duration when executed.

methods.name: MonkeyWaitEvent
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the event with the specified wait time.

methods.name: injectEvent
methods.description: Performs the wait event by sleeping for the configured wait time; logs the wait if verbose mode is enabled.
